Interface LettucePoolingClientConfiguration

All Superinterfaces:
LettuceClientConfiguration
public interface LettucePoolingClientConfiguration extends LettuceClientConfiguration
使用驱动级别的连接池为 Lettuce 配置 Redis 客户端，方法是向LettuceClientConfiguration添加特定的连接池配置。
Since:
2.0
Author:
Mark Paluch，Christoph Strobl，Yanming Zhou
